## Why This Is Asked

- On-device compute budgets and energy
- Encrypted indexes and redaction

```javascript
  return text.replace(rx, '[REDACTED]');
```

## Why This Is Asked

- Energy and bandwidth trade-offs

```javascript
function scoreEpisode(ep, history) {
  const recency = 1 / (Date.now() - ep.date);
  const similarity = history.tags.filter(t => ep.tags.includes(t)).length;
  return 0.6 * recency + 0.4 * similarity;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate the impact on retention and watch time?
- How handle eviction when cache fills and user turns off prefetching?

```javascript
}
```
